label: 2. If you're not occupied with anything at the mo…

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: If you're not occupied with anything at the moment,

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: can you help me with something important?
How important?

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Very Important.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Are you good at coming up with names?
Nobody does it better than me.
If I weren't a Commander, I'd do it for a living.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: I admire your confidence.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: I'm not entirely convinced,

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: but can you come up with something

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: for my raven?
You want to name your raven?

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: I think it's a good idea.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Do you have something in mind?
Pitch-black
Cawy

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: You can't be serious.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Even if you are, do you actually think

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: such a ridiculous name is befitting for my raven?

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: I wasn't going to take your suggestions that seriously in the first place,

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: but I didn't expect them to be this lame.
I think it's a cool name.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: It's so hilarious to see you say it with such confidence as well!

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: I'm officially speechless.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: I'll give you more time to think about it carefully.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Report back to me if you come up with anything.
All right.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: And please try to take it more seriously.
